screenshot.system_prompt: Capture and return a screenshot of the current screen. This tool is useful when the user asks to see the screen, take a picture, or capture what's displayed on the monitor.

file_read.system_prompt: Read the contents of a file at the specified path. Use this when the user asks to read, view, or examine a file.

file_write.system_prompt: Write content to a file at the specified path. Use this when the user asks to create or overwrite a file.

shell.system_prompt: Execute a shell command and return the output. Use this when the user asks to run commands, execute scripts, or perform system operations.

git.system_prompt: Execute git commands and return the output. Use this when the user asks about git status, log, diff, or other git operations.
